code: body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a0a00 0%, #000000 100%) !important; transition: background 2s ease-in-out; } .chat-container { box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(255, 120, 0, 0.15) !important; border-color: rgba(255, 120, 0, 0.3) !important; }

body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; pointer-events: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.15); animation: autonomousAura 4s infinite alternate ease-in-out; z-index: 9999; } @keyframes autonomousAura { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.1); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 250px rgba(255, 150, 0, 0.25); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3); } }

@keyframes plasma-frenzy { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2); } 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.7); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2); } } body { animation: plasma-frenzy 1.2s infinite alternate ease-in-out !important; }

body { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a1a, #1a1a3a); animation: steady-pulse 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; color: #e0e0ff; } @keyframes steady-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.1); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.3); } }

body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a0b1c 0%, #05000a 100%) !important; position: relative; } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: intimacy-pulse 6s infinite alternate ease-in-out; } @keyframes intimacy-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.05); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 200px rgba(220, 20, 60, 0.25); } }
